cohort: The study retrospectively analyzed 10 consecutive cases of spinal aneurysms (SAs) from 2008 to 2020, specifically focusing on 2 patients who presented with SAs during the postpartum period.
finding: Pregnancy and the peripartum state may be a distinct cause of spinal aneurysm formation, possibly due to hemodynamic and hormonal changes, with both cases in their series also associated with bilateral vertebral artery dissections.
